host_plugin.name: Advanced Custom Fields (field groups, post types, taxonomies, options and field values)

operations.name: list-field-groups
operations.description: List registered ACF field groups: key, title, a flattened summary of their location rules, and whether each is active

operations.name: get-fields
operations.description: Read a post's ACF field values, keyed by field name, via get_fields()

operations.name: update-fields
operations.description: Set one or more ACF field values on a post via update_field(). Snapshotted on the post target; restorable with rollback-operation. Disabled by default (site opts in via the wpmcp_enable_acf_write filter)

operations.name: batch-update-fields
operations.description: Set ACF field values on many posts at once. Every value is validated first and one invalid value refuses the whole batch. Each post is snapshotted under one session_id (returned), so rollback-session undoes the batch. Disabled by default (wpmcp_enable_acf_write filter)

operations.name: get-field-group
operations.description: Read one field group by key with every setting and its full field tree

operations.name: list-field-types
operations.description: List the field types this ACF install offers (name, label, category)

operations.name: list-post-types
operations.description: List ACF-registered post types: key, title, post_type slug, active, local

operations.name: get-post-type
operations.description: Read one ACF post type by key with every setting

operations.name: list-taxonomies
operations.description: List ACF-registered taxonomies: key, title, taxonomy slug, active, local

operations.name: get-taxonomy
operations.description: Read one ACF taxonomy by key with every setting

operations.name: validate-fields
operations.description: Check values against their fields with ACF's own validation (required, number range, email, URL, custom rules) without writing. Pass post_id so field names resolve by that post's groups

operations.name: get-options
operations.description: List options pages, or read one page's field values when page (its menu slug) is given. Needs ACF Pro

operations.name: update-options
operations.description: Set field values on an options page via update_field(). Snapshotted; rollback-operation restores the prior rows exactly. Needs ACF Pro. Disabled by default (wpmcp_enable_acf_write filter)

operations.name: save-field-group
operations.description: Create or update a field group. fields (optional) replaces the field list: keep a field by passing its key, omit it to delete it; each needs label, name and a type from list-field-types, and may nest sub_fields. Upsert by key (omit key to create). Snapshotted; rollback-operation restores it exactly. Disabled by default (wpmcp_enable_acf_write filter)

operations.name: save-post-type
operations.description: Create or update an ACF post type (registered by ACF on the next request). New ones need post_type (slug, max 20) and title (plural label); other ACF settings pass through. Upsert by key (omit key to create). Snapshotted; rollback-operation restores it exactly. Disabled by default (wpmcp_enable_acf_write filter)

operations.name: save-taxonomy
operations.description: Create or update an ACF taxonomy (registered by ACF on the next request). New ones need taxonomy (slug, max 32) and title (plural label); object_type lists post types. Upsert by key (omit key to create). Snapshotted; rollback-operation restores it exactly. Disabled by default (wpmcp_enable_acf_write filter)

host_plugin.name: Kadence Blocks, GenerateBlocks, Spectra, Otter Blocks, Blocksy Companion, Stackable, Ultimate Blocks

operations.name: list-suites
operations.description: The supported block suites: whether each is active, its version and block namespace, the attribute holding each block's unique id, and its CSS model (render_time: built from attributes on render; per_post_cache: a per-post stylesheet rebuilt after writes)

operations.name: get-block-schemas
operations.description: The active suite's blocks (block.json; Spectra: its attribute defaults, typed from the values; Spectra, Stackable, Ultimate Blocks: unknown attributes allowed). Without name: every block with title, parent/ancestor and attribute names. With name: that block with its full attribute definitions (type, default, enum)

operations.name: insert-block
operations.description: Insert one suite block, given as block markup (it may contain inner blocks), AT path in post id; expected_hash is the content_hash from parse-blocks. Attributes are checked against the block schema. A missing, duplicate or foreign unique id is generated the way the suite's editor does and replaces the old id or the __UNIQUE_ID__ placeholder in that block's markup; GenerateBlocks css is compiled from styles. Snapshotted: rollback-operation restores the post exactly and the suite CSS is rebuilt

operations.name: update-block
operations.description: Update the suite block at path: attrs are MERGED into its attributes (null removes one) and checked against the schema; the unique id cannot change. inner_html replaces a leaf block's markup. GenerateBlocks css is recompiled when styles change. Snapshotted like insert-block

operations.name: list-patterns
operations.description: Browse registered block patterns (core, theme and suite): name, title, categories, the suites whose blocks each uses and its remote image count. Filter by suite, category or search (name or title); paged by limit and offset. source:"directory" browses the WordPress.org Pattern Directory instead (core blocks only, no suite filter, category is a directory slug, limit up to 100, cached an hour); its names are directory:<id>. source:"spectra" browses Spectra's remote library while Spectra is active (free Gutenberg block patterns only, category is a library slug, limit up to 100, cached a day); its names are spectra:<id>

operations.name: get-pattern
operations.description: One pattern by a name from list-patterns: title, categories, the suites it uses, its remote images and its block markup

operations.name: import-pattern
operations.description: Insert registered pattern name (or a directory:<id> or spectra:<id> from list-patterns) AT path in post id (expected_hash from parse-blocks). Suite unique ids are made unique in the post as insert-block does. Remote images are sideloaded through the remote media host allowlist and their urls (and attachment ids) rewritten; others are kept and reported. sideload_images:false keeps all. One snapshot; rollback-operation restores the post (sideloaded media stays)

operations.name: get-settings
operations.description: Kadence Blocks or Spectra plugin settings with defaults, and the writable keys. API keys and secrets are never returned

operations.name: update-settings
operations.description: Set writable keys from get-settings. Kadence: {store: {key: value|null}} merged into that store. Spectra: {key: value}. One bad value refuses the batch. Snapshotted

operations.name: get-page-styles
operations.description: The CSS the suite generated for post id: Spectra's stored page CSS, version and fonts; Kadence builds CSS at render time, so its block ids instead

operations.name: rebuild-page-styles
operations.description: Drop Spectra's generated CSS for post id so it is rebuilt on the next view. Snapshotted

operations.name: get-otter-settings
operations.description: Otter Blocks: its feature switches and block settings (stored value or Otter's default), disabled blocks, and which API keys are set (never their values)

operations.name: update-otter-settings
operations.description: Otter Blocks: set features and settings by the keys get-otter-settings returns (booleans; disabled_blocks a list of block names). One bad key or value refuses the batch. Snapshotted for rollback-operation. Off by default (wpmcp_enable_otter_settings_write)

operations.name: get-otter-page-styles
operations.description: Otter Blocks: post id's generated stylesheet (file name, url, whether the file exists) and the CSS kept for it

operations.name: rebuild-otter-page-styles
operations.description: Otter Blocks: drop post id's cached stylesheet and have Otter generate it again (or on the next view). Snapshotted for rollback-operation

operations.name: list-forms
operations.description: List Contact Form 7 forms with id, title, and slug

operations.name: get-form
operations.description: Read one form: title, slug, the form markup, and the mail template

operations.name: list-fields
operations.description: List one form's fields as Contact Form 7 parses them out of the form markup: name, type, whether it is required, and its options

operations.name: list-notifications
operations.description: List a form's mail notifications: the primary Mail template and the optional Mail (2) autoresponder, each with whether it is active, recipient, sender, subject, and body template

operations.name: list-entries
operations.description: List a form's Flamingo-stored submissions, newest first (sender name, sender email and subject are MASKED; get-entry returns one in full), with paging (page_size default 20, max 100, plus offset) and a status filter (inbox, the default, plus spam and trash, which Flamingo keeps out of the default listing). form_id is required and is resolved to the form's Flamingo channel term; a form whose channel binding is missing is refused rather than answered with an unscoped listing. Requires the Flamingo plugin and the edit_users capability because submissions are user data

operations.name: get-entry
operations.description: Read one Flamingo-stored submission in full: subject, sender, channel, submitted fields, and meta. Requires the Flamingo plugin and the edit_users capability (the cap Flamingo itself gates inbound messages behind) because submissions are user data

operations.name: update-entry-status
operations.description: Move one Flamingo-stored submission between the inbox and the trash, through Flamingo's own trash()/untrash() so it lands where Flamingo's screen expects it. Snapshotted first and restorable with rollback-operation. Spam flagging is deliberately not offered: Flamingo reports spam to Akismet, which would send the submission to a third-party service. Requires the Flamingo plugin and the edit_users capability

operations.name: delete-entry
operations.description: Delete one Flamingo-stored submission. Default-off (opt in with wpmcp_enable_forms_write), requires confirm:true, the Flamingo plugin, and the edit_users capability. Reversible: a Flamingo entry is a flamingo_inbound post, so it is snapshotted (row, postmeta, channel terms) before deletion and can be resurrected at its original id with rollback-operation using the returned operation_id. Deletion is therefore NOT erasure: the snapshot keeps a verbatim plaintext copy of the submission (name, email, remote IP, message body) until Snapshot_Store prunes it. Restoring it is held to the same edit_users bar as deleting it (rollback-operation is otherwise an edit_posts ability), but the plaintext copy still exists, so use a real erasure tool if the goal is to destroy the data

operations.name: list-messages
operations.description: List a form's system messages (mail_sent_ok, validation_error and the rest) with the key of each, which update-messages takes

operations.name: update-notification
operations.description: Edit one mail template of a form (mail or mail_2): enabled (mail_2 only), subject, body, sender and reply_to. Recipients are changed with set-notification-recipients. Off by default (opt in with wpmcp_enable_forms_write). Returns before and after of every changed field. Undo: rollback-operation

operations.name: set-notification-recipients
operations.description: Change who a mail template is sent to: to (the recipient), cc and bcc (kept in the template's additional headers; an empty string removes one). This redirects personal data, so it needs confirm:true, and the confirmation shows the recipients before and after. Off by default (opt in with wpmcp_enable_forms_write). Undo: rollback-operation

operations.name: update-messages
operations.description: Set some of a form's system messages (mail_sent_ok, validation_error and the rest; keys from list-messages). Values are plain text up to 400 characters. Off by default (opt in with wpmcp_enable_forms_write). Returns before and after. Undo: rollback-operation

operations.description: List Fluent Forms forms with id and title

operations.name: get-form
operations.description: Read one Fluent Forms form with its decoded field definitions

operations.name: list-fields
operations.description: List one form's fields: input name, element type, label, and whether it is required

operations.name: list-notifications
operations.description: List one form's email notifications: id, name, whether it is enabled, who it is sent to, subject, and message template

operations.name: list-entries
operations.description: List a form's entries, newest first, with paging (page_size default 20, max 100, plus offset) and an optional status filter (unread, read, spam, trashed; without one, trashed entries are left out like Fluent Forms' own screen does). Requires manage_options because entries are user data

operations.name: get-entry
operations.description: Read one entry in full: form, serial number, status, date, submitted response, and IP address. Requires manage_options because entries are user data

operations.name: update-entry-status
operations.description: Set one entry's status to unread, read, spam, or trashed, and fire Fluent Forms' own after-status-update action. Snapshotted first (a before-image of the submission row) and restorable with rollback-operation. Requires manage_options

operations.name: delete-entry
operations.description: Permanently delete one Fluent Forms submission with its values, logs and meta (the rows of fluentform_submissions, _submission_meta, _logs and _entry_details, removed directly: Fluent Forms' own delete hooks do not run, uploaded files stay on disk, and queued scheduled actions are left alone). Refused with entry_has_payments when the submission has a payment record. Off by default (opt in with wpmcp_enable_forms_write); needs confirm:true and manage_options. Reversible: every row is snapshotted first and rollback-session puts them back. Deletion is NOT erasure: the snapshot keeps a verbatim copy of the submission until Snapshot_Store prunes it.

operations.name: list-forms
operations.description: List Formidable forms with id, name, and form key

operations.name: get-form
operations.description: Read one Formidable form (name, key, description, options)

operations.name: list-fields
operations.description: List one form's fields: id, key, type, label, whether it is required, and options for choice fields

operations.name: list-notifications
operations.description: List one form's email notifications (Formidable "email" form actions): id, name, whether it is active, recipient, sender, subject, and message template

operations.name: get-entry
operations.description: Read a single entry with its field values by entry id. Requires manage_options because entries are user data

operations.name: delete-entry
operations.description: Permanently delete one Formidable entry with its values and, for a repeater or embedded form, its child entries; refused with entry_has_payments when it has a payment or subscription record (the rows of frm_items and frm_item_metas, removed directly: Formidable's own delete hooks do not run and uploaded files stay on disk). Off by default (opt in with wpmcp_enable_forms_write); needs confirm:true and manage_options. Reversible: every row is snapshotted first and rollback-session puts them back. Deletion is NOT erasure: the snapshot keeps a verbatim copy of the submission until Snapshot_Store prunes it.

operations.name: list-confirmations
operations.description: List one form's confirmations (Formidable "on_submit" form actions): id, name, enabled, type (message, page, redirect), message, page id and redirect url. A form that still keeps its confirmation in its own options is reported as legacy, read-only

operations.name: update-notification
operations.description: Edit one email action (notification) of a form: enabled, name, subject, message, from and reply_to. Recipients are changed with set-notification-recipients. Off by default (opt in with wpmcp_enable_forms_write). Returns before and after of every changed field. Undo: rollback-operation

operations.name: set-notification-recipients
operations.description: Change who an email action is sent to: to, cc and bcc (addresses or field shortcodes such as [admin_email]; an empty cc or bcc clears it). This redirects personal data, so it needs confirm:true, and the confirmation shows the recipients before and after. Off by default (opt in with wpmcp_enable_forms_write). Undo: rollback-operation

operations.name: update-confirmation
operations.description: Edit one confirmation (on_submit action) of a form (needs confirm:true; the confirmation shows the confirmation before and after, since a redirect sends visitors, and smart tag values, to another page): enabled, name, type (message, page, redirect), message (post HTML only), page (id of a published page) and redirect (an http or https url). The result must be coherent for its type. Off by default (opt in with wpmcp_enable_forms_write). Returns before and after. Undo: rollback-operation

operations.name: list-forms
operations.description: List Forminator forms with id, display name, status, and the shortcode that embeds each form

operations.description: Read one Forminator form: display name, embed shortcode, and its fields (id, type, label, required)

operations.name: list-entries

operations.name: get-entry

operations.name: delete-entry

Off by default (opt in with wpmcp_enable_forms_write); needs confirm:true. Reversible: every row is snapshotted first and rollback-session puts them back. Deletion is NOT erasure: the snapshot keeps a verbatim copy of the submission until Snapshot_Store prunes it.

operations.name: list-forms
operations.description: List GiveWP donation forms with id, title, status, and running earnings and sales counts

operations.name: get-form
operations.description: Read one donation form: title, status, and its curated configuration (price, price option, donation levels, goal option and amount, earnings, sales)

operations.name: list-donations
operations.description: List GiveWP donations, newest first: id, status, date, amount, currency, form, campaign, donor id, gateway, mode; donor name and email MASKED. Filter by status, form_id, donor_id, campaign_id, mode (live or test), from and to (YYYY-MM-DD)

operations.name: list-donors

operations.name: donation-summary

operations.name: update-form
operations.description: Change a GiveWP donation form: title, status (publish, draft, pending, private), price (the set amount, single-amount forms only), goal_enabled, goal. Visual form builder forms take status only. Snapshotted; undo: rollback-operation

operations.name: update-donation-status
operations.description: Change a GiveWP donation's status (complete, pending, processing, refunded, failed, cancelled, abandoned, revoked, preapproval) through GiveWP, which recalculates totals and may email the donor; no gateway refund is made. operations.name: code-snippets-get-snippet
operations.description: Read one Code Snippets snippet with its code and, for PHP, a static check report (advisory)

operations.name: code-snippets-create-snippet
operations.description: Create a PHP snippet in Code Snippets, always inactive; code failing the static check is refused. Snapshotted; rollback deletes it

operations.description: Activate a Code Snippets PHP snippet, so it runs on every request. Refused unless PHP execution is enabled (WPMCP_ALLOW_PHP_EXEC, default off) and the environment permits it; stored code is re-checked. Every attempt audited. Snapshotted; rollback deactivates

operations.description: Deactivate a Code Snippets snippet (never gated, so a snippet can always be switched off). Snapshotted

operations.name: code-snippets-trash-snippet

operations.name: wsform-list-forms
operations.description: List WS Form forms: id, label, status (draft, publish, trash), whether the editor has unpublished changes, shortcode, and submission counts (total, unread, spam, trash) counted live. status filters; trash is left out unless asked for

operations.name: wsform-get-form
operations.description: Read one WS Form form: label, status, shortcode, counts, and its tabs with their sections and fields (id, type, label)

operations.name: wsform-list-notifications
operations.description: List one WS Form form's email notifications (its "email" actions): row id, label, active, to, cc, bcc, from, reply-to, subject and message template

operations.name: wsform-list-entries
operations.description: List a WS Form form's submissions newest first: id, status, starred, viewed, dates and every field value MASKED (wsform-get-entry returns one in full). status: publish, draft (in progress), error, spam or trash; by default all but spam and trash, as WS Form lists them. page_size (default 20, max 100) and offset. Personal data

operations.name: wsform-get-entry
operations.description: One WS Form submission in full: status, starred, viewed, dates, user, every field value (key, label, type, value), tracking data such as the IP address, the actions log and the wp-admin notes. Personal data

operations.name: wsform-update-entry-status
operations.description: Set a WS Form submission's status (publish, draft, spam or trash), starred and/or viewed. Undo: rollback-operation

operations.name: everestforms-list-notifications
operations.description: List one Everest Forms form's email notifications: connection id, name, active, to, from name and email, reply-to, subject and message template

operations.name: everestforms-list-entries
operations.description: List an Everest Forms form's entries newest first: id, status, starred, viewed, date and every field value MASKED (everestforms-get-entry returns one in full). status: publish, spam, trash, draft, pending, approved or denied; by default all but spam, trash and draft. page_size (default 20, max 100) and offset. operations.name: everestforms-get-entry

operations.name: everestforms-delete-entry
operations.description: Permanently delete an Everest Forms entry with its stored values. Uploaded files stay on disk. Needs confirm:true. Undo: rollback-session reinserts every row

operations.name: activitylog-get-activity
operations.description: One WP Activity Log or Simple History event in full: user, roles, severity, event, object, message, IP address, user agent and every metadata or context value. source when both plugins are active. Personal data

operations.description: List Action Scheduler queue actions (WooCommerce and many plugins use it): id, hook, status, group, schedule, scheduled time (UTC; for a finished action the last attempt) and args with emails, IPs and tokens MASKED. Idempotent: re-running against an existing wpmcp-scaffolded child completes or reports it instead of failing. Refuses to build a child of a child (no grandchildren). Requires confirm:true, the edit_themes capability, file editing to be allowed on the site, and the wpmcp_enable_theme_write opt-in. Snapshotted before any file is written; rollback-operation removes the scaffold again (unless it has since been activated). Does not activate the child theme

slug.description: Directory slug for the child theme; defaults to {parent}-child. Sanitized to a safe key, confined to the themes directory

name.description: Human-readable theme Name header; defaults to "{Parent Name} Child"

parent.description: Stylesheet directory of an installed parent theme; defaults to the active theme's template. Must not itself be a child theme

operations.name: get-site-identity
operations.description: Read the site identity and homepage settings: name, tagline, home and site URL, language, timezone, logo (custom_logo theme mod) and icon (site_icon) with their attachment ids and URLs, show_on_front with the front page and posts page, and the permalink structure

operations.name: set-site-logo

operations.name: set-site-icon
operations.description: Set the site icon (favicon, the site_icon option) to an image attachment of at least 512 by 512 pixels, or pass null to remove it. operations.name: set-permalink-structure

operations.name: flush-rewrite-rules

operations.name: find-pattern-usage

operations.name: create-synced-pattern

operations.name: create-export-request
operations.description: File a personal data export request for an email address, as Tools > Export Personal Data does. send_email:true mails the requester the confirmation link and leaves the request pending; without it the request is filed as confirmed. Refuses an incomplete request already on file for that email. Undo: rollback-session trashes the request (a sent email stays sent). Disabled by default (wpmcp_enable_core_privacy_write filter)

operations.name: create-erasure-request
operations.description: File a personal data erasure request for an email address, as Tools > Erase Personal Data does. It erases nothing itself: an administrator runs the erasure from that screen once the request is confirmed. Needs the top-level confirm:true parameter of theme-write, next to operation and args (not inside args); the refusal shows the email, the matching user and the registered erasers first. send_email:true mails the confirmation link and leaves it pending; without it the request is filed as confirmed. Undo: rollback-session trashes the request. Disabled by default (wpmcp_enable_core_privacy_write filter)

operations.name: mark-request-complete
operations.description: Mark a personal data request completed with the current time, as core's "Mark as complete" does. Refuses a request that is already completed. Snapshotted; undo: rollback-operation. Disabled by default (wpmcp_enable_core_privacy_write filter)

operations.name: list-dynamic-sources
operations.description: List the {{group.field}} binding tokens a single, archive or search template can print (post, site, archive, search and loop fields, plus ACF fields when ACF is active), each with the type that decides its escaping, and the placeholder syntax

operations.name: preview-dynamic-template
operations.description: Render a stored dynamic template with its bindings resolved against post_id (a loop repeats over recent posts of that post type), without changing the site

operations.name: create-dynamic-template
operations.description: Create a single, archive or search template shown where its conditions match (same rules as site parts). content is block markup with {{group.field}} tokens from list-dynamic-sources; unknown tokens and rules that cannot match the context are refused. Undo with wpmcp/delete-site-part

operations.name: update-dynamic-template
operations.description: Edit a dynamic template's title, content, conditions or priority; omitted fields are kept and the context is fixed. Snapshot-first: operation_id rolls it back

operations.name: list-forms
operations.description: List WPForms forms with id and title

operations.name: get-form
operations.description: Read one WPForms form with its decoded field definitions

operations.name: list-fields
operations.description: List one form's fields: id, type, label, whether it is required, and choices for choice fields

operations.name: list-notifications
operations.description: List one form's email notifications: id, name, whether it is enabled, recipient, sender, reply-to, subject, and message template, plus whether notifications are switched on for the form at all

operations.name: list-entries
operations.description: List a form's entries, newest first, with paging (page_size default 20, max 100, plus offset) and an optional status filter (spam or trash; without one every entry is listed, each with its status). Needs WPForms entry storage and manage_options because entries are user data

operations.name: get-entry
operations.description: Read one entry in full: submitted field values, status, starred/viewed flags, date, IP address, and user agent. Needs WPForms entry storage and manage_options because entries are user data

operations.name: update-entry-status
operations.description: Move one entry between active, spam, and trash through the WPForms entry handler. Snapshotted first (a before-image of the entry row) and restorable with rollback-operation. Needs WPForms entry storage and manage_options

operations.name: list-confirmations
operations.description: List one form's confirmations (what a visitor sees after submitting): id, name, type (message, page, redirect), message, page id and redirect url. A form saved before confirmations existed reports its single legacy one as id 1

operations.name: update-notification
operations.description: Edit one notification of a form: enabled, name, subject, message, sender_name, sender_address and replyto. The recipient is changed with set-notification-recipients. Off by default (opt in with wpmcp_enable_forms_write). Returns before and after of every changed field. Undo: rollback-operation

operations.name: set-notification-recipients
operations.description: Change who a notification is sent to (to: one or more addresses or smart tags such as {admin_email}). This redirects personal data, so it needs confirm:true, and the confirmation shows the recipient before and after. Off by default (opt in with wpmcp_enable_forms_write). Undo: rollback-operation

operations.name: update-confirmation
operations.description: Edit one confirmation of a form (needs confirm:true; the confirmation shows the confirmation before and after, since a redirect sends visitors, and smart tag values, to another page): name, type (message, page, redirect), message (post HTML only), page (id of a published page) and redirect (an http or https url). The result must be coherent for its type. Off by default (opt in with wpmcp_enable_forms_write). Returns before and after. Undo: rollback-operation
